[EN] Possibly, a few seconds have passed. The onlookers reopened their eyes, with great fear of what a horrible and brutal sight awaits them. To be precise, it was horrible and brutal but not the kind they were expecting. It was the one with the sword bleeding profusely from his, very likely shattered, nose and lying on the ground.
The one with the club, quite understanably, was trembling with fear and decided to leg it. He tossed his club away and ran as far as he could. Sensible people would just let him go by now. She was not a sensible person. She rushed to the running man and punched him right in the forehead. Then, something amazing happened. The man was lifted up in the air from the impact. While the man was briefly breaking the laws of gravity like they were mere parking tickets, the woman began to throw multiple blows at him. The witnesses all say that it was something rather beautiful. A piece of art, to be more precise.
As the man was about to hit the ground,she gave a final kick and the man tumbled towards a fruit stand nearby. She gave the owner of the fruit stand 3 pieces of gold for the damage and told the owner that
"When these major malfunctioning numbnuts wake up, tell them, it ain't a gentleman-like behaviour to attack a lady while wielding weapon."
[ES] Posiblemente, habían pasado unos pocos segundos. Los espectadores reabrieron los ojos con gran temor ante la horrible y brutal escena que les aguardaba. Para ser precisos, era horrible y brutal, pero no del tipo que esperaban. Era el tipo de la espada sangrando profusamente por su nariz, muy probablemente destrozada, y tirado en el suelo.
El de la mazo, comprensiblemente, temblaba de miedo y decidió poner pies en polvorosa. Tiró su mazo y corrió tan lejos como pudo. La gente sensata lo habría dejado ir a estas alturas. Ella no era una persona sensata. Corrió hacia el hombre que huía y le dio un puñetazo directo en la frente. Entonces, ocurrió algo asombroso. El hombre se elevó por los aires debido al impacto.While the man was briefly breaking the laws of gravity like they were mere parking tickets, the woman began to throw multiple blows at him. Todos los testigos afirman que fue algo bastante hermoso. Una obra de arte, para ser más precisos.
Cuando el hombre estaba a punto de golpear el suelo, ella le dio una última patada y el sujeto tropezó contra un puesto de frutas cercano. Le dio al dueño del puesto de frutas 3 piezas de oro por los daños y le dijo al dueño que
"Cuando estos imbéciles disfuncionales se despierten, díganle que no es de caballeros atacar a una dama portando armas."
